name: Short Cut Wild Rice Bowl with BBQ Pulled Pork Rice, Coleslaw & Corn

ingredients.name: wild rice medley with herbs, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Squeeze rice pouches to separate grains, then tear a two-inch opening at the top of each to vent. Place both pouches in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, about 2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (8.8 oz) pouch wild rice medley with herbs, pre-cooked

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, transfer shredded cabbage to a medium bowl; drizzle with dressing packet and stir to combine the coleslaw. Set aside.

Remove and discard outer sleeve from pork, then puncture pouch with a fork or knife on one side (leave pouch in the microwave-safe tray). Place in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from microwave, let cool for 1 min, then carefully open pouch and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (16 oz) pkg barbecue pulled pork, fully-cooked

instructions.primary_message: While the pork is heating, drain corn in a colander.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8.5 oz) can whole kernel corn, canned

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice, coleslaw, pork, and corn between bowls. Enjoy!
